fixed.problem: Blocking item from the review: a regression in L4h-left-1, which may never be cut. In chat or by voice, 'mark the digest page done anyway, the client accepted it as it is' (the person's own words as the note) was refused with '"Write the digest page" is failed now, so it cannot be done; nothing changed.' Before this area, it answered the failed task's card with Mark done anyway. Root cause: moveAsCardAnswer (packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts) kept the move off the card whenever the person's own note met an option that takes no note. It never checked whether the move itself could run. A failed or needs_human task cannot move to done (TASK_TRANSITIONS), so assertMove refused it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/chat-final.test.ts 'fixup-l4-chat-final, run L4: a move the task cannot make answers the card, also with the person's own note' > 'Mark done anyway with the person's own note, in chat and by voice, from a failed task and from one that waits for the person: ...' and '... after a restart the read-back still says the note is not kept, and the yes answers the card'. Also apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-chat-final, run L4' > 'fixup-l4-chat-final: POST /chat: the person's own words to mark a failed task done anyway answer its card's Mark done anyway; the read-back says their note is not kept'. All three failed on 8288019 sources (checked by putting the old task.ts and request.ts back) and pass now.
fixed.how: moveAsCardAnswer(ctx, params, option, movable) keeps the move for the person's note only when movable(task) is true. task.transition passes canTransition(TASK_TRANSITIONS, status, to). task.resume passes its own plan checks: needs_human, plus someone other than the person for Go ahead without. Cancel task is still kept, so its note still reaches the brief. In every other case the card is answered with its option and the person's note travels in request.answer's params. request.ts askOf then ends the read-back with ' Your note is not kept.' when the source is chat or voice, the note is the person's own (notesPersons), and the option cannot carry a note. The person learns this before they say yes. A note the model made up is left out of the read-back, as before.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench (--provider bench --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_FAIL=digest --env FORERUNNER_BENCH_FAIL_MODE=error): make a project with a ready task 'Write the digest page' and Start. The task fails and its card (Try again / Mark done anyway / Cancel task) appears in the Inbox. In the project's Chat send: tool: task_transition {"task": "Write the digest page", "to": "done", "note": "the client accepted it as it is"}. The read-back reads 'Mark done anyway ("Write the digest page" failed)? Closes it although nothing passed review. Your note is not kept.' Press Yes. The chat says '"Write the digest page" is done: accepted without review.' The card is answered and the task is Done. Walked on bench fixup-l4-chat-final: /tmp/frbench/fixup-l4-chat-final-shots/02-done-2-readback.png and 03-done-3-after-yes.png. live_check (real model): with a failed task's card open, type 'mark the digest page done anyway, the client accepted it as it is'. Expect the Mark done anyway read-back with 'Your note is not kept.' and no refusal. After Yes the task is done and the card is answered. 'cancel the digest page, the customer dropped the digest' still cancels it, and the reply ends 'Your note goes into its brief if you reopen it.'

fixed.problem: Non-blocking review items (L4h-left-4 words). (1) A card that needs this computer's OK, answered in chat with a note the model made up, got the reply 'Nothing else was filed; type the note there with Try again.' That asks the person to type a note they never gave and cannot see. (2) The same reply printed the model's raw answer ('with try_again') instead of the option's label.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/chat-final.test.ts 'a card that needs this computer's OK: the reply says where the person's note goes, or that it was not kept' (its model-note line was changed for the design, see tests_changed_for_design) and 'a card that needs this computer's OK, answered by the model in its own words: the reply names the card's option as its button says it'
fixed.how: executor.ts mentions the note only when it is the person's own (notesPersons). A note the model made up gets the plain 'Nothing else was filed.'. cardTitleOf returns {title, takesNote, label}. It matches the answer the way request.answer does (case, spaces, _ and - are ignored), and the reply names the option's label.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Unit-tested only; not walked on the bench, because a card that failed 4 times needs four failed runs. live_check: with a task's 'failed 4 times' card open, type 'try X again'. If the model adds a note of its own, the reply ends 'Nothing else was filed.' with no 'type the note there'. Type 'try X again and tell it to use the old layout'. The reply ends 'Nothing else was filed; type your note there with Try again.'

fixed.problem: Non-blocking review item (L4h-left-4 Done line): appliedChanges matched a left_out entry with startsWith on the change's bare line. A change whose line only starts the line of another, left-out change was counted as left out. A set with an applied change and a drop then said 'Changed 2 tasks.' and dropped 'your next Start runs them.'

The reply is now the plain 'Nothing else was filed.', as with no note. The person's-note lines are unchanged.

notes_for_other_areas: moveAsCardAnswer(ctx, params, option, movable) in packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts takes a fourth argument. A redirect keeps the move for the person's note only when movable(task) is true. Any new command that redirects to a card must pass its own plan's checks there.
request.ts askOf(r, answer, ctx, note, given) ends the read-back ' Your note is not kept.' for the person's own note (chat or voice) on an option that takes none.
executor.ts cardTitleOf now returns {title, takesNote, label}. The answer_on_card reply mentions only the person's own note and names the option by its label.
task-proposal-words.ts appliedChanges matches a left_out entry as '<line without period>: '.
